genre.en: a street-culture and design magazine editorial: real city streets, confident, graphic, natural light

s: the shoes stand on a pale-concrete step against a muted sky-blue wall, hard afternoon sun throwing their sharp shadows long across the step
a pair of feet mid-stride in the shoes on a city crosswalk, low sun from behind, crisp long shadows, the street softly blurred
the shoes rest on a sage-green paper sweep, a shaft of hard window light falling across them and the floor

a single running shoe planted on the white-line-painted rubber of an outdoor running track lane, the track a decided terracotta orange, hard late-afternoon sun raking from camera-left so the shoe throws a long razor-edged shadow across the lane lines, the shoe filling most of the frame

the shoe wedged mid-stride into the lane of a brick-red track with a pair of mud-flecked running legs stepping off the line behind it, low hard sun from behind casting a long crisp shadow of the shoe toward the camera, the shoe large in the foreground

the pair of shoes sitting on a deep-sea-blue painted wooden gym bench in a school gym locker corner, a hard shaft of window light from the upper right slicing across them and laying sharp slatted shadows on the bench and floor

the shoe hanging by its laces from a chain-link fence beside a tomato-red basketball court surface, hard noon sun from directly right throwing a crisp lattice shadow of the fence and the shoe onto the court, the shoe big and sharp in frame

the pair of shoes lined up on the concrete sideline step of a mint-green painted outdoor court, hard side sun from camera-right throwing their long sharp shadows across the painted lines, the shoes filling the lower two-thirds of the frame

the pair of shoes resting on the worn top step of a terracotta-orange painted stairwell at the entrance of an old apartment building, hard afternoon sun from the left door opening throwing a sharp diagonal shadow of the shoes down the steps, the shoes large in frame

a single shoe on a sage-green tiled bathroom floor by a doorway, a hard beam of morning light through a frosted window from upper left casting the shoe's crisp shadow and a window-grid shadow across the tiles, the shoe filling the frame

the pair of shoes set on a deep-navy-blue wooden bench at a sidewalk cafe in a narrow street, low hard sun from camera-right throwing long sharp shadows across the bench slats, the street softly blurred behind

the shoes tucked beside a front door on a mustard-yellow painted entryway floor at home, hard light from a doorway on the right laying a sharp rectangular light patch and the shoes' dark shadow across the floor, the shoes dominant in the frame

a pair of feet in the shoes stepping off a curb painted tomato red on a city street, hard low sun from behind casting crisp long shadows of the feet and shoes toward the camera, the shoes large in the lower frame
